task.label: 능글맞은 20대 초반(중저음 + 살짝 허스키)
texts: 거짓말. 안 켜면 그냥 안경이잖아. 난 모리. 근거 없는 말은 안 믿어. 그래서, 나랑 무슨 상관인데? 흐음, 인정. 이번엔 네 말이 맞았어.
task.instruct: Cartoon cat sidekick, a young man in his early twenties. Youthful mid-low voice with a light husky grain, not deep, not old. Laid-back and charming with an audible smirk, teasing the friend he likes, quick and easy conversational tempo, smooth confident delivery, clear Korean articulation. Playful sarcasm, never mean, never gruff.
